summary: This report provides the results of a speed limit review conducted on Warden Avenue, between Kingston Road and Danforth Avenue. The analysis concludes that a 40 km/h speed limit is not technically justified on this section of Warden Avenue. However, engineering judgement dictates that a 40 km/h limit would increase safety along the subject section of road. The Warden Avenue consists primarily of single family dwellings along this section of road where there are numerous pedestrian generators including nearby schools, several places of worship, public library and commercial plaza's. Reduced speed limit would increase the overall safety of pedestrians, cyclists and other traffic utilizing this section of Warden Avenue.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council reduce the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Warden Avenue, between Kingston Road and Danforth Avenue.
